title: Research Input
description: Schema for the research intake form submitted to the Research Intelligence Orchestrator.

topic.description: The main research topic or question. Must be specific enough to generate meaningful search queries.
examples: Machine learning methods for early detection of Alzheimer's disease
Ethical use of artificial intelligence in higher education assessment
Sustainable building materials in tropical climates

discipline.description: The primary academic discipline of the research.

research_depth.description: How many papers to retrieve and analyze.

citation_format.description: Reference style for the generated bibliography.

include_pdf_processing.description: Whether to attempt full-text extraction for open-access PDFs. Requires document-processor service.

keywords_override.description: Optional: override the AI-generated keywords with specific terms.

exclusion_terms.description: Terms to exclude from search results.

min_citations.description: Minimum citation count for included papers (0 = no minimum). Note: recent papers may have few citations.

approval_required.description: Whether to pause the workflow for human review before generating the final report.
